punchline: Every night at a set time, Arianna Huffington 'gently escorts' her phone out of the bedroom.
thirty_sec: After collapsing from exhaustion in 2007, Arianna Huffington rebuilt her evenings. At a fixed time each night she turns off her devices and walks them out of the bedroom. Then a hot bath with Epsom salts and a candle. She stopped sleeping in her gym clothes and now has pajamas only for sleep. Sometimes there's chamomile tea. She calls it a sacrosanct ritual, and her book argues for seven to eight hours without leaning on pills.
